186060.text: straighter line on middle and leg, very tight from AK. Turned to on side and that's stumps on DAY 1
186060.postText:
That was some recovery from the visitors. From a precarious 16/3, Australia A have done a commendable job to finish the day on 282 for 7, driven largely by a heroic effort from their lower-middle order. They added 112 runs in the final session, with the crowning moment being Sam Harper's superb, unbeaten century. Liam Scott and Todd Murphy played vital hands as well. India A's new-ball bowlers were disciplined, Anshul Kamboj in particular was economical but it was Shams Mulani and Nachiket who led the wicket column with three apiece. However, the real story of discipline remains those 21 no-balls, an astonishing 14 of which came from Mulani - an unforgivable tally for a spinner. 

That wraps up our coverage for Day 1. Do join us tomorrow for all the action from Day 2. This is Thilak Ram, signing off alongside Binoy George and Chetan Kumar. See ya tomorrow.
